info.name: OpenFEMA Catalog Web Disaster Summaries API

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData-style filter expression, e.g. state eq 'FL' and fyDeclared eq 2024. The parser is strict about spacing, quoting, and capitalization; string literals must be single-quoted.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

params.name: $top
params.description: Number of records to return. Defaults to 1000 when omitted; maximum of 10000 per call.

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of records to skip, used to page through results beyond $top.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Field name to sort results by.

params.name: $format
params.description: Response format. Defaults to json when omitted.

params.name: $metadata
params.description: When false, suppresses the metadata envelope object and returns only the data array. Accepts true/false (the legacy on/off values are deprecated).

params.name: $count
params.description: When true, includes the total matching record count in the metadata envelope. Replacement for the deprecated $inlinecount parameter.

params.name: $allrecords
params.description: BETA. When true, forces the full result set to be returned in one download, overriding the 10000-record $top ceiling. Intended for bulk export, not interactive paging.

items.docs: Returns per-disaster financial summary totals (Individual Assistance, Public Assistance, and Hazard Mitigation) sourced raw from NEMIS.
